questions.q: Pen is to Write as Knife is to ___
questions.explanation: A pen is used to write, just as a knife is used to cut.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: B, D, G, K, ___
questions.explanation: The gaps grow by one (+2, +3, +4), so K + 5 = P.

questions.q: If 4 machines make 4 parts in 4 minutes, how long will 8 machines take to make 8 parts?
questions.explanation: Each machine makes one part in 4 minutes, so 8 machines still need 4 minutes for 8 parts.

questions.q: If DOG is coded as 26 (4 + 15 + 7), what is CAT coded as?
Bird is to Nest as Bee is to ___
questions.explanation: Birds live in nests, just as bees live in hives.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 100, 90, 81, 73, ___
questions.explanation: The drops shrink by one (-10, -9, -8), so 73 - 7 = 66.
8, 27 and 64 are perfect cubes (2^3, 3^3, 4^3); 100 is not.

questions.q: Some pens are pencils. All pencils are erasers. Which conclusion is valid?
questions.explanation: The pens that are pencils must also be erasers, so 'some pens are erasers' follows.
